subject: Extract details on Pareto K after fitting a model

messages.author: e8e2387233c35cd4
messages.subject: Extract details on Pareto K after fitting a model
parts:
Hi,
thanks for the great package and the help forum. 

When fitting models I often experience high Pareto ks. How can I extract information for Pareto k, other than the warning that is displayed?

 I would like to get something like this as available from the standard Stan code:

Computed from 12000 by 20 log-likelihood matrix Estimate SE elpd_loo -1875.5 83.0 p_loo 32.6 2.0 looic 3751.0 166.0 ------ Monte Carlo SE of elpd_loo is NA. Pareto k diagnostic values: Count Pct. Min. n_eff (-Inf, 0.5] (good) 0 0.0% <NA> (0.5, 0.7] (ok) 0 0.0% <NA> (0.7, 1] (bad) 16 80.0% 21 (1, Inf) (very bad) 4 20.0% 9 See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.

I might be obvious, but I seem to be unable to extract these bits of information.
thanks a lot!
Franziska

messages.author: cf19ade26e5385d2
messages.subject: Re: Extract details on Pareto K after fitting a model
parts:
Hi Franziska,

You can utilize the 'extract_ic' function to get the Pareto k diagnostic values you inquired about.
For a comprehensive understanding of this function, please visit the following link: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/develop/R/R/extract_ic.R.

Please do not hesitate to reach out if you need further assistance.

Best,
Eunhwi
